ValidationRule.description: Prevent users from setting ‘Start Date’ to be the same as ‘Next Payment Date’ as the Repayment Schedule will not create payments when this occurs.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start Date cannot be the same date as Next Payment Date. Start Date should be at least 1 business day prior to the desired Next Payment Date. If you leave Next Payment Date blank, the system will populate it to the earliest date available upon save
